objective: Upgrade Coins from a cosmetic-only sink into a scarce adaptive reward token that can unlock either verified System cosmetics or budget-gated discretionary real-world reward choices, without creating a fixed coin-to-currency exchange rate, a second finance owner, automatic spending authority, reward farming, or loss of existing progression/shop protections.

roles_before.artifact: XP is irreversible progression awarded from verified scored Quest v2 outcomes and is not a spendable currency.
Quest Difficulty/Reward v1 issues 0/0/1/2/4/8 coins for E/D/C/B/A/S verified scored outcomes; outcome_key prevents duplicate farming.
system-shop-economy:v1 permits only non-repeatable System-fulfilled cosmetic rewards at 1/2/4/8 coins.
Sleep, ordinary rest, food, water, medication, health care, safety and mandatory duties cannot be coin-gated.
Coins have no cash value and System redemption cannot authorize purchases, payments, subscriptions, bookings or other external actions.
Ron OS finance/live evidence owns affordability and current budget truth; Neon System state does not own bank balances or spending capacity.
Neon system_events is the single mutable owner of configured System shop items and redemptions.
Shop configuration and redemption are user-directed internal System actions under Internal System authorization v1.
The recorded base SHA reconstructs the complete cosmetic-only economy and pre-change runtime.

role_dispositions.destination: XP remains non-spendable irreversible progression; reward-economy v2 does not alter XP calculation or deduction semantics.
Existing E-S coin issuance and outcome-key anti-farming remain unchanged in this slice; v2 adds no daily/routine coin faucet.
system-reward-economy:v2 preserves cosmetic rewards and adds REAL_WORLD_CHOICE rewards whose coin redemption only unlocks/records a discretionary choice after a fresh finance gate.
Protected needs and mandatory duties remain forbidden as reward-shop gates or rewards.
A real-world-choice redemption records internal eligibility/choice only; external_action_authorized remains false and any purchase/payment requires a separate explicit external action.
Current discretionary affordability is checked from fresh finance evidence at redemption; no financial balance or standing TL cap is mirrored into Neon.
Shop configuration/redemptions remain append-only system_events; reward metadata and finance-gate provenance travel with those events rather than creating another store.
Exact item activation and redemption remain user-directed; architecture promotion itself does not activate a reward or spend money.
Base SHA remains the rollback point and historical shop/player events are not rewritten.

capability_probes.assertion: Existing verified cosmetic candidates remain valid, permission-gated and redeemable under the same coin/economy/non-repeatable checks.
Reward-economy v2 cannot encode or derive a fixed Coin-to-TRY/USD exchange rate and a coin redemption alone never authorizes an external payment.
A REAL_WORLD_CHOICE cannot be redeemed without fresh APPROVED current-discretionary-budget evidence and cannot use protected needs or mandatory duties as rewards.
Quest scoring, E-S XP/coin issuance, outcome-key anti-farming, focus/timing and atomic resolution remain unchanged.
System events do not become an owner of bank balances, salary, savings or discretionary budget; finance gate stores only redemption-time provenance/cap evidence.
Recorded base SHA restores the cosmetic-only shop policy and complete prior runtime without rewriting ledger history.

tests.expected: Cosmetics remain valid; REAL_WORLD_CHOICE supports 4/8/16 tiers, rejects fixed cash conversion, and requires a fresh approved finance gate before a redemption plan is created.
Final migration accepts configured budget-gated real-world choices but rejects redemption without valid fresh finance evidence; redemption remains internal and coin-bounded.
Existing quest, timing, focus, progression, shop, achievement, profile and action-gate tests remain green.
Architecture, controller and continuity guards pass with reward-economy v2.
Existing player-facing System projection remains valid; no unrelated UI regression or second state owner appears.
